turns.content: Hello, I'm your doctor today. What brings you in today?
I’ve had a cough, and I’ve also been coughing up blood. I also have a cough that produces colored or more abundant sputum than usual.
To start, how long have you been experiencing the cough and hemoptysis?
I don’t know.

I don’t know.
Do you currently smoke, or have you ever smoked?
I don’t know.

I don’t know.
Have you noticed any chest pain, especially when taking a deep breath or coughing?
I don’t know.
Are you currently taking any blood-thinning medications, such as aspirin, warfarin, or newer anticoagulants?
I don’t know.
Are you coughing up just small streaks of blood mixed into the sputum, or are you coughing up larger, distinct amounts of blood?
It’s coughing up blood. I don’t know whether it’s small streaks or larger distinct amounts.
What specific color is the sputum you are coughing up (e.g., yellow, green, rust-colored, or pink/frothy)?
I don’t know.
Have you had any recent respiratory infections, or do you have a known history of chronic lung disease?
Yes—I have chronic obstructive pulmonary disease (COPD) and I have cystic fibrosis. I also have a cough producing colored or more abundant sputum than usual. I’m also immunosuppressed.
